tools.name: make_er_diagram
tools.description: Use this when the user wants an ER diagram, entity relationship diagram or database schema diagram drawn from SQL CREATE TABLE statements, for example "draw an ER diagram of this schema" or "make a PDF of my database tables". Takes the DDL text, a dialect (auto, postgres, mysql, sqlite), a page size

tools.name: check_schema
tools.description: Use this when the user wants SQL CREATE TABLE statements checked without a drawing, for example "check my schema for broken foreign keys" or "which tables have no primary key". Takes the same DDL text and dialect as make_er_diagram. Returns foreign keys that point to a missing table or column, forei
